description: BTK sent communications to media, citizens, and police between 1974 and 1988, claiming responsibility for several killings.
coding_note: Communication is coded as documentary and communication evidence.

description: BTK sent crime-scene photographs to law enforcement and media.
coding_note: Photographs are coded as documentary and communication evidence; depicted locations are not automatically coded as location evidence.

description: In 2004, BTK sent police a photograph of a murder victim who had not previously been linked to him.
coding_note: Coded as documentary and communication evidence; the photograph itself is not treated as location evidence.

description: The final BTK communication included a computer floppy disk.
coding_note: The disk is physical, digital, documentary and communication evidence; its contents were forensically examined.

description: Investigators recovered a deleted file from the disk containing the name Dennis and a Wichita church.
coding_note: Digital/documentary evidence with a documented location association and forensic examination.

description: Computers and digital material associated with Rader were examined during the investigation.
coding_note: Computer/device is physical and digital evidence; examination is forensic and associated with a documented location.

description: A search of Rader's home revealed souvenirs from victims.
coding_note: Physical evidence recovered at a documented location.

description: A search of Rader's home revealed abduction kits.
coding_note: Physical evidence recovered at a documented location.

description: DNA evidence was used during the investigation to help identify Rader.
coding_note: Coded as biological and forensic evidence.

description: After his arrest, Rader confessed to the killings.
coding_note: The confession is treated as communication and testimonial evidence, not automatically documentary evidence.

description: DNA from sexual-assault and homicide victims was linked to one person across the California cases.
source_title: NIJ: Serial Killer Connections Through Cold Cases
coding_note: Represents the documented crime-scene biological evidence and cross-case linkage.

description: Forensic genetic genealogy was used with the unknown DNA profile to identify relatives and generate investigative leads.
source_title: NIJ: Just Science — Investigative Genetic Genealogy
coding_note: Forensic genetic genealogy is coded as biological + forensic; the database/search process is not itself classified as digital evidence.

description: A biological sample from material discarded by Joseph DeAngelo provided the confirming DNA comparison.
source_title: NIJ: Serial Killer Connections Through Cold Cases
coding_note: Physical biological material recovered from discarded material and used for forensic DNA comparison.

description: Fingerprints were lifted from Golden State Killer crime scenes.
coding_note: Fingerprint evidence is coded as physical + location + forensic; biological remains 0 because our biological feature is limited to biological material or DNA.

description: Shoe-tread impressions were collected from Golden State Killer crime scenes.
coding_note: Physical impression evidence associated with documented crime scenes and forensic examination.

description: The offender ransacked homes and took coins, jewelry, and identification from victims.
source_title: FBI East Area Rapist / Golden State Killer Campaign
coding_note: Physical items taken from documented crime locations; coded as physical and location evidence.

description: During the series of burglaries, the offender took items including coins, jewelry, and identification from victims' homes.
source_title: FBI East Area Rapist / Golden State Killer Campaign
coding_note: Specific physical property associated with documented crime locations; no inference is made that the property independently identified DeAngelo.

description: Investigators used fingerprints lifted from crime scenes as part of the evidence collected in the cold case.
coding_note: Kept as a separate evidence category from the discarded biological sample; coded as physical, location-associated, and forensic, not biological under our definition.

description: Madoff's account balances and paperwork showed major discrepancies, including balances off by more than $100 million.
coding_note: Financial and documentary evidence documenting discrepancies.

description: Madoff's staff created fake financial statements and strategies to match earlier paperwork.
coding_note: Financial/documentary evidence; the documents were fabricated records.

description: Real DTC statements were obtained and used as models for copied/fake statements.
coding_note: Documentary financial evidence; DTC records are official transaction-related records.

description: Computer programmers produced false documents and trading records to support the fraudulent scheme.
source_title: SEC: Jerome O'Hara and George Perez
coding_note: Digital/documentary/financial evidence based on computer-produced records.

description: Bogus trades, trade blotters, stock records, customer confirmations, and DTC reports were created to conceal the fraud.
coding_note: Financial and documentary records; many were fictitious and created after the fact.

description: The Ponzi account could not meet investor withdrawal requests; investors requested about $1.5 billion while only about $300 million was in the bank.
coding_note: Financial evidence representing the documented mismatch between liabilities/withdrawal requests and available funds.

description: Madoff told FBI agents there was no innocent explanation and that he had been running a massive Ponzi scheme.
coding_note: Coded as communication and testimonial evidence.

description: Frank DiPascali's testimony was described by the FBI as essential to the government's cases against Madoff's staff.
coding_note: Coded as testimonial evidence; no physical or financial feature is inferred merely from the subject matter of testimony.

description: A damaged rear axle from the truck bomb was recovered and contained a vehicle identification number.
coding_note: Physical vehicle evidence associated with the bombing scene; identifying number was used for tracing.

description: The vehicle identification number on the axle was traced to the Ryder rental truck used in the bombing.
coding_note: The VIN is documentary/identifying information on a physical vehicle part; it is not classified as digital evidence.

description: Ryder rental records connected the truck to the rental transaction in Kansas.
coding_note: Rental records are documentary evidence with a location association and financial/transaction context.

description: A composite drawing of the person who rented the truck was produced from information obtained at the rental location.
coding_note: The sketch is documentary evidence based on investigative information and tied to the rental-location investigation.

description: Dreamland Motel records identified Timothy McVeigh as a guest in Junction City.
coding_note: Hotel registration is documentary evidence associated with a documented location.

description: Chemical residue from the explosive was found on McVeigh's clothing after his arrest.
coding_note: Physical/forensic evidence: clothing contained residue chemically associated with the explosive.

description: A business card on which McVeigh had written a note about TNT was found.
coding_note: Physical documentary evidence containing written communication/information.

description: McVeigh's fingerprints were found on a receipt at Nichols' home for 2,000 pounds of fertilizer.
coding_note: The receipt is documentary/financial-context evidence and the fingerprint is physical/forensic; biological remains 0 under our definition.

description: Michael Fortier provided information about McVeigh's plans and the bomb plot.
coding_note: Coded as testimonial/communication evidence; no stronger physical feature is inferred.

description: Shrapnel from a 1987 Unabomber bomb was recovered from the Salt Lake City bombing.
coding_note: Physical bomb-component evidence associated with a documented crime scene.

description: Recovered bomb components from Unabomber devices underwent forensic examination.
coding_note: Represents documented technical examination of physical bomb components.

description: The Unabomber sent a 35,000-word manifesto in 1995.
coding_note: The manifesto is documentary and communication evidence.

description: David Kaczynski provided letters and documents written by Theodore Kaczynski to the FBI.
coding_note: The supplied writings are documentary evidence; the transfer of the material is a documented communication.

description: FBI linguistic analysis found strong similarities between Kaczynski's writings and the manifesto.
coding_note: Coded as documentary and forensic/technical analysis of written material.

description: Agents found bomb-making components, including chemicals, metal/plastic pipe, wire, and other materials in Kaczynski's cabin.
coding_note: Physical evidence recovered from a documented location.

description: Agents found approximately 40,000 handwritten journal pages containing bomb-making experiments and descriptions of Unabomber crimes.
coding_note: Handwritten journals are documentary evidence associated with the cabin and contain descriptions of crimes.

description: Agents found a live bomb ready for mailing in Kaczynski's cabin.
coding_note: Physical explosive device recovered from a documented location; coded only under the universal physical/location/forensic scheme.
